# Finite reached-condition branching and question recovery

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Finite guarded, sequential and choice program questions compile exactly to native questions. Complete translated-answer agreement and receiving-side finite branching match finite macro histories over different native programs, preserving endpoint answers. Fixed words embed exactly; moving a guard earlier is sound if every prefix endpoint preserves it.

Canonical source: [Granularity.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Granularity.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Supplied finite loop-free Program syntax, native processes, atomic-question correspondence and guards interpreted at reached positions.
- Cross-program matching requires complete initial translated-answer agreement and receiving-side ImageFinite; safe early testing requires guard preservation at all prefix endpoints.

Every execution projects to a native path in the same process. Guards and administrative steps contribute no represented physical events and do not establish sensing, learning or resource implementation.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Lean 4.29.1: 35 new declarations / 314 closure audits, 279 inherited separate; new 12 empty and 23 standard, 9 with classical choice. New modules use autoImplicit false; frozen sources/logs/checker hashes are bound. Author counterreview, no independent-agent acceptance.

Does not cover unbounded loops, actual guard acquisition, probabilities, deployment termination or internal-position translation across arbitrary syntax; the early-testing condition is sufficient only.

- The same process changes canFinish through formation; testing early and after arrival yields different outcomes. [ExplanatoryResumptionCases.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/deeper/ExplanatoryResumptionCases.lean)
